system.name: Skyler
system.one_liner: a static analysis framework for pre-deployment cost estimation of API invocations in serverless workflows

components.name: IaC Template
components.role: infrastructure-as-code template input to the graph generator

components.name: Serverless Graph Generator
components.role: parses IaC templates and code to build a unified representation of control and data flows

components.name: Serverless Graph
components.role: unified graph representation of the application's control and data flow

components.name: Cloud Service Equations Plugins
components.role: provider-specific pricing plugins (e.g. S3, SQS, aws, FS, Pub/Sub) that capture cloud billing semantics

components.name: Cost Modeling Engine
components.role: traverses the graph and instantiates symbolic cost equations using the pricing plugins

components.name: Cost Equation

components.role: runs analysis queries over the cost model to explore costs, cost concentration, or input sensitivity

components.name: Q1 Q2 Q3

components.name: Cost Metrics (Final Report)
components.role: final predicted-cost output of the framework

content.key_idea: Skyler's three-stage pipeline (serverless graph generation, provider-specific cost modeling, and symbolic query simulation) turns application code and IaC templates into predicted API costs before deployment.

summary: This figure shows the architecture of Skyler, a static-analysis framework that predicts the monetary cost of API calls in serverless applications before deployment. Application source code and an IaC template (plus an API profile) feed a Serverless Graph Generator, which builds a unified control/data-flow graph. A Cost Modeling Engine then traverses this graph, combining it with provider-specific Cloud Service Equations Plugins (covering services such as S3, SQS, and Pub/Sub) to instantiate a symbolic cost equation. Finally, a Symbolic Simulation Engine executes analyst-supplied queries (Q1-Q3) over the cost model to explore provider-specific costs, cost concentration, or input sensitivity, producing a final Cost Metrics report. The diagram is drawn as a left-to-right pipeline of gray boxes, with three colored dashed bands along the bottom labeling which paper section (§4 graph generation, §5 pricing modeling, §6 cost-prediction queries) documents each stage.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Skyler 的三阶段流水线架构：代码和 IaC 模板构建无服务器图，结合云服务定价插件生成符号成本方程，再由符号模拟引擎执行查询得出成本报告，底部三色虚线框对应论文§4-§6节。
